## MechWarrior 1 Remake 1.1.5

A crash at quit fixed, and a cleaner copy of MechWarrior (1989). Nothing in play changes.

- **A crash at quit after the sound output changed** (headphones or a headset plugged in or out while playing) is fixed: the Remake now uses SDL 3.4.20.
- **NEV_UNIV.EXE is no longer copied in.** The download of MechWarrior (1989) carries this tool beside `BTECH.EXE`; it is not part of the game and nothing uses it, so the Remake's copy of your MechWarrior (1989) leaves it out. Your own folder is not changed.

Saved games are unchanged: 1.1.5 reads and writes the same saves as 1.1.4.

You still need your own copies of MechWarrior (1989), MechWarrior 3 and Pirate's Moon.
